title: First-Principles Derivation of Adaptive-Resolution Molecular Dynamics
exact_target: Explain why the adaptive-resolution coupling is force based and derive that force interpolation from statistical mechanics.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30000953 (OWR-1966-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Atomistic Models of Materials: Mathematical Challenges (2008), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2008/21, pp. 1079--1156; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF pages 28--30.
Delle Site 2007; reference in the saved dated catalogue literature review.

status_qualification: The report supplies an argument against a particular potential-interpolation scheme and leaves a first-principles force derivation open. It does not establish that every conceivable energy-based coarse-graining is impossible; that stronger conclusion is not part of the target.
